items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text says the law that follows came from the LORD, spoken to Moses.

items.quote: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
items.claim: On the day of his cleansing, the leper is to be brought to the priest.

items.quote: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
items.claim: The priest goes outside the camp and looks at the leper to see whether the leprosy has healed.

items.quote: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
items.claim: The priest orders that two live clean birds, cedar wood, scarlet and hyssop be taken for the person being cleansed.
items.object: two birds alive and clean, cedar wood, scarlet, hyssop

items.quote: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
items.claim: The priest orders that one bird be killed in a clay pot over running water.
items.action: shall command that one be killed
items.mechanism: killing done in an earthen vessel over running water

items.quote: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
items.claim: The living bird, the cedar wood, the scarlet and the hyssop are dipped in the blood of the bird that was killed.
items.object: living bird, cedar wood, scarlet, hyssop
items.mechanism: dipping in the blood of the killed bird

items.quote: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
items.claim: The priest sprinkles the person seven times, declares him clean, and releases the living bird into the open field.
items.action: shall sprinkle, pronounce clean, and let loose
items.object: him that is to be cleansed; the living bird
items.mechanism: sprinkling seven times, declaring him clean, releasing the bird
